comment: Only the seventh output can be polyphonic, and only through the 'Polyphony on 7th out' menu item; the panel marks it with a P. The bipolar button is a single light latch that applies to all seven oscillators, unlike modulator7 where each has its own. The seven outputs are configured with empty names (Modulator7Compact.cpp:71), which is why the census shows no name for them. The xRate presets are ten separate menu items rather than a submenu.
